notes.title: Upcoming DLC, Features and Updates!
notes.content:
Hello to all Potty-Brained Throne Protectors out there! This is just a quick update to let you know what's to come for Throne of the Dead in the coming weeks and months. 

Our plan for Throne of the Dead is to keep it updated regularly, this can range from simple bug fixes, tweaks or even new features and DLC. As such, the following are features that we plan on adding sometime in the future: 

- Boss Waves
- More variation of Zombie Types
- A Wider Range of Power Ups, including More Guns! 

We won't provide a definitive date as to when these features will be added as we don't want to make any false promises. But rest assured they will be coming, and with more details soon!

We'd also like to take this opportunity to announce our upcoming DLC for Throne of the Dead. The Halloween DLC and Christmas DLC. Both DLC's will go live in October and December respectively. 

Both of these DLC's will be completely free for anyone who owns the base game! We will have more details on the Halloween DLC very soon!
